recent_news.headline: LiqTech QureFlow Expected to Enable More Than 95% Wastewater Recovery at WWIS's New Texas Facility
recent_news.summary: LiqTech International announced its QureFlow QF-6 ceramic membrane filtration system will support wastewater reuse at Water Works Industrial Services' new facility in Freeport, Texas, enabling over 95% wastewater recovery. The system was initially announced in August 2026.
